Alex K: Quick postmortem follow-up: need owners/timelines for rollout safety (auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, recurrence detection).
Maria P: I can own auto-rollback. Will post multi-signal thresholds + short canary plan by Thu EOD.
Jon S: Ill take blast-radius controls (flag scoping + saturation caps). ETA next Tue.
Irene C: Ill prototype recurrence detection rules (flag+model grouping) and wire alerts; target: end of sprint.
Taylor R: Ill draft a 1-page oncall checklist for rollback validation and verification; due Mon.
Alex K: Paste for quick rollback sketch:
```nfeature_flag: new_vector_routing
stages: [1% 30m, 10% 3h]
rollback_if: (p95>200ms AND user_errors>1%) within 10m
cooldown: 15m
bucket_max_users: 5000
```
Jon S: Note infra review required for global quarantine switch (30s TTL) and token caps.
Alex K: @remind-bot set reminder: rollout-safety sync in 7 days. Prioritize safety over velocity for next month.
remind-bot: Reminder scheduled by Alex K: "rollout-safety sync" in 7 days.
